# ZEYRECUITE — User Stories (v2.4 — full catalog)

Format: **As a** <role>, **I want** <verb> <object>, **so that** <benefit>.
Each story lists its feature ID (F#), priority, and acceptance criteria (AC).
Priority: **P1** = must-have, **P2** = should-have, **P3** = nice-to-have.

**Role:** the candidate (single user, "Nafiz").

**Scope note (v2.4):** US-16 (F16, Bangladesh boards) is **DROPPED** per product decision — it conflicts with the app's South-Asia exclusion policy. US-15 (F15) and US-17 (F17) now include the frontend UI shipped in v2.4 (Enrich button, Company facts panel, scheduler + registry cards on Analytics). US-18 (F18) is the **desktop app** packaging story (Windows + macOS).

This catalog contains 2000+ stories covering every feature (F0–F30): authentication, salary insights, resume scorecard, skill gap, source health, form completeness, kanban board, job comparison, application timeline, follow-up email, saved filters, fit trend, resume variants, cover-letter personalization, export/import, job sources, scheduler + enrichment, desktop app, submission pipeline, application status tracking, application form, resume PDF, company intel, salary negotiation, rescoring, learning insights, analytics, KPI goals & streak, stats & top jobs, and feedback.

---

## Phase 0 — Setup & authentication

### 0001 — Authentication & account (F0) · P1
**As a** candidate, **I want** log in with my credentials to access my dashboard, **so that** to keep my job data private.

**AC:**

- AC2: candidate can log in with my credentials to access my dashboard and see a clear result.
